newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends flat in range-bound trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends flat in range-bound trade.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed barely moved against the dollar on Friday, with activity confined to the forwards market, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 58.49 to the dollar, after opening at 58.48.

"There was hardly any activity in the spot market, but forwards were somewhat active. Banks either bought to cover forward imports, or thought it was a reasonable level at which to accumulate forwards," said a Commercial Bank dealer.
Overnight call money closed at 9.375 percent, after opening at 9.75 percent and rising to 10, dealers said.
Dealers say the dollar-rupee exchange rate should remain at current levels, unless there is a large import bill, due to the market being well supplied with dollars.
